text:
Character will normally move in the direction <PAD=Ｌ３>
is moved. Tilt <PAD=Ｌ３> slightly to move slowly, and
tilt it all the way to move quickly
Character will ascend while <PAD=＄Ｌ１> is pressed.

Character will descend while <PAD=＄Ｌ２> is pressed. You
can descend all the way from the air until you
land on the ground.

Press <PAD=＄×> while pressing <PAD=＄Ｌ１> to use a Quick Ascend.
Quick Ascends consume Ki and cannot be used without it.

Press <PAD=＄×> while pressing <PAD=＄Ｌ２> to use a Quick Descend.
Quick Descends consume Ki and cannot be used without it.

Press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> quickly on the ground to perform a Jump.
Press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> again while jumping to ascend.

Press <PAD=＄×> near an opponent or quickly moving <PAD=Ｌ３>
to perform a Step.

Press <PAD=＄×> while moving <PAD=Ｌ３> to perform a Dash. Move
freely in any direction quickly as you consume Ki.

Press <PAD=＄×> without moving <PAD=Ｌ３> to use a Homing Dash.
Press <PAD=＄×> while Homing Dash to cancel the move.
Press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> during a Homing Dash to do a Sudden Stop.

Press <PAD=＄×> while canceling Homing Dash. You will
super-dash and move behind the opponent.

Press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> during a Super Dash to do a Sudden Stop.
Ki spent by Dash will only be for the distance up
to the Sudden Stop.

Press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> and <PAD=＄Ｌ２> at the same time to use a Super 
Rising. This makes it possible to move quickly in the air.

Press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> during a Super Rising to do a
Sudden Stop. Through Sudden Stop, other actions
will become immediately available.

Press <PAD=＄×> during <PAD=＄Ｌ１>＋<PAD=＄Ｌ２> Super Rising to connect 
Super Dash!

Press <PAD=＄□> to use punches and kicks in a Rush Attack.
The Rush Attack accepts <PAD=＄□> command up to 5 times.

Hold down <PAD=＄□> to use Charge Attacks. The force of a
Charge Attack depends on the length you hold<PAD=＄□>.

Keep holding <PAD=＄□> to use a Charge Attack: Max.
You can blow away your opponent in the direction
you tilt <PAD=Ｌ３>.

Press <PAD=＄□> while moving <PAD=Ｌ３> greatly in one direction
to use a Charge Attack while moving.

Press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> quickly while on the ground to jump.
Press <PAD=＄□> while jumping to perform Jump Charge
Attacks.

Press <PAD=＄□> and release <PAD=＄□> while holding <PAD=＄×>
to perform. This can perform during Dash or Homing Dash.

Press <PAD=＄△> after <PAD=＄□> to do a Smash Attack: 1.
It will turn your opponent around.

Press <PAD=＄△> after pressing <PAD=＄□> twice for Smash
Attack: 2. It breaks your opponent's defense.

Press <PAD=＄△> after pressing <PAD=＄□> 3 times for Smash
Attack: 3. It activates consecutive attacks.

Press <PAD=＄△> after pressing <PAD=＄□> 4 times to use Smash
Attack: 4. It stiffens your opponent.

Press <PAD=Ｌ↑>and <PAD=＄△> during a <PAD=＄□> Rush Attack to
use Smash Attack: High.

Immediately after Smash Attack: High with <PAD=□> then
<PAD=Ｌ↑> + <PAD=△>, press <PAD=×> to chain into an Air Combo and
then repeatedly press <PAD=□> to beat down your opponent.

Press <PAD=Ｌ↓>and <PAD=＄△> during a <PAD=＄□> Rush Attack to use
Smash Attack: Low.

After a <PAD=Ｌ↓>＋<PAD=＄△> Smash Attack: Low, press <PAD=＄△>
to connect Assault Chase. There are
different types depending on character.

Press <PAD=Ｌ↓> + <PAD=＄Ｒ１> + <PAD=＄○> simultaneously to perform on
downed opponent. Positioning and attack type is
different for each character.

After a <PAD=＄□> Charge Attack and blow away opponent,
press <PAD=＄×> and then hold down and release <PAD=＄□>
to use Pursuit Attack: 1.

Blow away opponent with a <PAD=＄□> Charge Attack and use 
Pursuit Attack: 2 with <PAD=＄□>.

Pursuit Attacks can blow away your opponent in the 
direction <PAD=Ｌ３> is tilted.

Press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> and <PAD=＄○> by your opponent to use an Throw. 
When a Throw is used by a wall it becomes a Crash.

Rush Attacks and other attacks can be defended 
with <PAD=＄Ｒ１>'s Normal Defense. There are attacks that 
will shave off your health or break your Defense.

Use <PAD=＄Ｒ１> and <PAD=＄□> to dodge Rush Attacks. Sways only 
prevent Rush Attacks and can be called an advanced 
technique.

Use <PAD=＄Ｒ１> and <PAD=＄△> to avoid Smash Attacks. Counters 
require ready timing.

Press <PAD=＄×> while holding <PAD=＄Ｒ１> to disappear and dodge 
attacks. The direction you re-appear in changes 
based on the direction you move <PAD=Ｌ３>.

Press <PAD=×> in time with your opponent's attack to use
Steps. Then you can dodge melee attacks during a
Step's period of invincibility.

Use Recovery from Faint at the instant you 
crash into the ground to perform a Roll.

While performing Roll, press <PAD=＄×> to quickly move 
towards your opponent with a Sudden Dash.

Repeatedly press one of the <PAD=□△○×> buttons to
recover from a knock down.

Tilt <PAD=Ｌ３> left and right while holding <PAD=＄Ｒ１> to use Ki 
Blast Deflects. Against Charge Ki Blast, time your 
deflection to return it to your opponent.

Press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> in time with your opponent's throw to 
perform a Throw Evasion.

Press <PAD=Ｐ㊦> to do Ki Charging and charge up your Ki.
Connecting with Rush Attacks will also charge up
your Ki.

Press <PAD=＄△> to spend Ki and use Rush Blasts. The 
number of Rush Blasts that can be fired is 
different for each character.

Hold down <PAD=＄△> to use more Ki and fire a Charge Ki 
Blast. Charge Ki Blasts have different types for 
each character.

From the ground, press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> quickly and <PAD=＄△> to fire 
this.

From the ground, press <PAD=＄Ｌ１> quickly and hold <PAD=＄△> to 
fire this. Charge Ki Attack's power changes based 
on the length <PAD=＄△> is pressed.

When <PAD=Ｐ㊦> is pressed to use Ki Charging and Ki is 
charged up beyond the Ki Gauge, Ki fills the 
Tension Gauge.

Ki Charging cannot be performed until High Tension
ends. Ultimate Attacks can be used in High Tension
mode.

After the Tension Gauge is charged up, a Raging 
Soul can be activated (generally) once per battle 
with <PAD=＄Ｒ１>.

Repeatedly press <PAD=＄×>while tilting <PAD=Ｌ３> to perform 
Vanishing Move. Super/Ultimate Attacks cannot be 
used during Raging Soul mode.

Super Attacks can be used by tilting  <PAD=Ｒ３> in each 
direction. Super Attacks require more than a 
half-filled Ki Gauge.

Ki consumption, force and effect are different for
each Super Attack. You can change equipped Super
Attacks with Customize.

Your health needs to be 1 bar or less to display 
Super Attack's BOOST.

When 2 well-matched allies meet certain
requirements with either their Super or Ultimate
Attacks, they can perform a Team Super Attack.

Ultimate Attacks can be used in High Tension mode 
by pressing <PAD=Ｒ㊦>. Its force is far greater than 
Super Attacks.

Signature Skills are used with <PAD=＄○> and are unique 
for every character. They are available anytime as 
long as you have Ki.

When a specific character is on your side and your
opponent's health is below one bar, press the
Super Attack BOOST to use Team Super Attacks.

Press <PAD=Ｐ㊧Ｐ㊨> while holding <PAD=＄Ｒ２> down to display
a switching palette. Press a part corresponding
button to switch characters.

Switch with the character used just before to 
perform Quick Change.

Press <PAD=Ｐ㊧Ｐ㊨> while holding <PAD=＄Ｒ２> down to display
a switching palette. Press a part corresponding
button to consume Ki and transform characters.

After switching, the switching palette will 
temporarily turn gray, and you will not be able to 
switch again until the color returns.

Along with Switching, you can use Quick Change for 
Transformation too. However, this is not available 
for characters that cannot transform back into their 
original form.

Press <PAD=Ｐ㊧Ｐ㊨> while holding <PAD=＄Ｒ２> down to display
a switching palette. Press a part corresponding
button to perform Fusion.

BOOST is displayed when your opponent performs 
Switch. It is important to press buttons quickly 
for a High-Speed Blow Exchange.

When both sides use Homing Dash and collide,
a Blow Exchange will be activated. Rotate <PAD=Ｌ３> more
times than your opponent.

When certain Ki-firing Super Attacks crash into
each other, a Shot Exchange will be activated.
Rotate <PAD=Ｌ３> more times than your opponent.

Press <PAD=＄×> during a Rush Attack to use a Rush 
Vanishing. The place you re-appear will change 
based on the direction <PAD=Ｌ３> is tilted.

Hold <PAD=＄□> for Charge Attacks while Dashing to
perform MAX-Charge Attack while Dashing.

At the moment your character starts to flash by 
holding <PAD=＄□>, release the button to use a Charge 
Attack: Snap.

At the moment your character starts to flash by 
holding <PAD=＄△>, release the button to use a Charge Ki 
Blast: Snap.

Hold down <PAD=＄△> for a Smash Attacks except for Smash 
Attack: 3 to use Snap as a Charge Attack.

Except for Ki Blasts, press <PAD=＄Ｒ１> with good timing 
against your opponent's attack to use a 
Snap-Vanishing.

When you tilt <PAD=Ｌ３> left and right while holding 
<PAD=＄Ｒ１> against certain Ki-shooting Super Attacks, you 
can use a Super Attack Deflect.

When pressing <PAD=×> to follow up on a blown away
opponent (such as a <PAD=□>Charge Attack), tilt <PAD=Ｒ３> to
release Super Attack instead of <PAD=□>Pursuit Attack: 1.

Cancels are different for every character. Goku 
can perform a Cancel Attack by pressing <PAD=＄○> after 
<PAD=＄□＄□＄△>.

When using a Smash Attack during Raging Soul, 
press <PAD=＄×> to re-appear behind your opponent with a 
Derived Vanishing.

You can deflect Ki Blast by pressing <PAD=＄Ｒ１> when it 
flies in. Against Charge Ki Blast, time your 
deflection to return it to your opponent.

Character will be knocked out when the Health gauge
becomes 0. The Health stock will display if you have
more than 1 health bar.

While in High-Tension mode, use Pursuit Attack: 1 
or Pursuit Attack: 2 against your enemy 
to finish and you can inflict significant damage.

You can become this after charging the Tension Gauge 
by charging your Ki. Ultimate Attacks are available 
when in High-Tension mode.

Activate by pressing <PAD=＄Ｒ１> after the Tension Gauge is 
filled. During battle, Raging Soul is available as 
many times as you want.

During Raging Soul, you can chain together more Assault
Chase attacks than usual.
